name: appwrite-postgres-migration
description: Migration tool for moving from Appwrite to PostgreSQL

scripts.setup-schema: node -e "require('fs').readFile('postgres_schema_complete.sql', 'utf8', (err, data) => { if (err) throw err; console.log('Run this SQL in your PostgreSQL database:'); console.log(data); })"
scripts.status: echo 'Check STATUS_CHECK.md for current status' && cat STATUS_CHECK.md
